subject: Application for Network Security Engineer | Immidiate Joiner | 3+ years exp
body:
Dear Recruiter,

I hope you are doing well.

I am writing to express my interest in any Technical Security Engineer / Network Security Engineer opportunities. I have 3+ years of experience in Check Point, Palo Alto, FortiGate, firewall management, VPN, NAT, AlgoSec (AFA & FireFlow), SmartConsole, network security operations, and troubleshooting.

My last working day with my current organization is 27 July 2026, and I will be available to join thereafter.

Please find my resume attached for your review.

https://drive.google.com/file/d/1TGptz1VbYe3o2EjW2LnhBgCJTPcliHQJ/view?usp=drivesdk

I would appreciate the opportunity to discuss my profile and explore any suitable openings.

Thank you for your time and consideration. I look forward to hearing from you.


Best Regards,
Mangesh Pandhare
